constructive_conventions.antipedal: Intersections of consecutive supporting lines through the original vertices perpendicular to vertex-minus-focus vectors.
constructive_conventions.area: Cyclic ordered signed shoelace area, including self-intersecting stars and antipedals.
constructive_conventions.pedal: Perpendicular feet from the fixed original focus to original chord supporting lines.

earlier_valid_same_target_proof.author: Alper Ferudun
earlier_valid_same_target_proof.title: Focal Pedal-Antipedal Area Products in Elliptic Billiards

excluded_domains: repeated lower-period lists used to alter period parity
literal_imported_statement: Fix an ellipse with center $O$ and foci $f_1,f_2$, and let $P=(P_i)_{i=1}^N$ range over its Poncelet family of $N$-periodic billiard orbits tangent to a fixed confocal caustic. Let $P'$ be the outer polygon formed by consecutive tangent intersections and $P''$ the inner polygon of caustic tangency points; write $A,A',A''$ for their areas. The antipedal polygon of a polygon $R$ with respect to $M$ has sides through its vertices perpendicular to the corresponding $R_i-M$; $A_M^*,C_0^*,C_2^*$ denote its area and centroids, with primes for $R=P'$. Prove that, for $N\equiv0\pmod4$, $M=f_1$ or $f_2$, the quantity $A_MA_M^*$ is constant as $P$ varies through the family. The source labels this assertion invariant code k_{403,b}.
qualified_proved_target: For a noncircular outer ellipse a>b>0 and a fixed strictly nested nondegenerate confocal elliptical caustic, every primitive billiard family of least period N divisible by four, including coprime star windings, has phase-independent original-side-line pedal signed area times original-vertex-line antipedal signed area at either fixed original focus. Both foci give the same value; all real antipedal intersections are finite, and zero or negative antipedal signed area is permitted.
source_qualification: Neither Table 5 nor the imported statement explicitly says least/primitive. Least primitive period is the conventional unrepeated interpretation adopted and proved here. An unrestricted periodic-list interpretation is false.
